POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, JANUARY 13, 2025
  1500 HUGHES WAY STE. C-300 LONG BEACH, CA 90810
  HOUSING AUTHORITY, 2:00 PM

Sarah Bedy, Member  Doug Killion, Member
Pam Chotiswatdi, Member  Julie Lie, Member

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

Chair Sarah Bedy, called the meeting to order at 2:03 p.m. For the record member Kimberly Lewis is
no longer serving on the subcommittee.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lewis, Lie

Also present: Stephanie Sosa, Community Program Specialist, Jennifer Santana, Secretary.

Chair Sarah Bedy presiding.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-53986  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Policy Subcommittee meeting of
  Monday, December 9, 2024.

  A motion was made by Member Chotiswatdi, seconded by Member Killion, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Lewis

2.  25-53987  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the Clean Sweeps Public
  Works transfer cost opportunity with Homeless Services Staff.

  A motion was made by Member Killion, seconded by Member Lie, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4 Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0 None

  Page 1 of 4
   POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, JANUARY 13, 2025
  1500 HUGHES WAY STE. C-300 LONG BEACH, CA 90810
  HOUSING AUTHORITY, 2:00 PM

  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 1 Lewis

  • Members of the committee continued discussion on possible reallocation of
  PW funds to another program, they do however have concerns around the
  reallocation of funds causing job loss.
  • The subcommittee discussed developing a budget for a 24/7 staffed
  restroom and the potential for launching a pilot program, which could be
  incorporated into the September budget.

3.  25-53988  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the City of Long Beach’s 2025
  goals to increasing shelter beds and rates.

  • The subcommittee would like this item to be carried over to continue
  receiving updates.
  • Members of the subcommittee have questions around the number of shelter
  beds within the city. Staff will work on providing the subcommittee the
  information requested.

  A motion was made by Member Chotiswatdi, seconded by Member Killion, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Lewis

4.  25-53989  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the planned outreach
  initiatives and programs specifically targeted at older adults experiencing
  homelessness.

  A motion was made by Member Killion, seconded by Member Lie, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Lewis

  Page 2 of 4
   POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, JANUARY 13, 2025
  1500 HUGHES WAY STE. C-300 LONG BEACH, CA 90810
  HOUSING AUTHORITY, 2:00 PM

  • The subcommittee requested information on programs targeted towards
  assisting the elderly population.

5.  25-53993  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the winter shelter updates.

  A motion was made by Member Killion, seconded by Member Chotiswatdi, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Lewis

  • Members of the subcommittee expressed concerns about the low capacity of
  shelter beds, the would like to see more collaboration between the city
  and nonprofits to expand the number of available beds.
  • Members would like to see the shelter beds open earlier in the year.
  • Members and staff exchanged conversations around the RFP process and
  funding challenges for service providers.
  • A member of the public asked for clarification on what is the CoC board, staff
  responded.

6.  25-53990  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion regarding future agenda items.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Killion, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Lewis

  • The subcommittee would like to discuss the 1955 Long Beach Blvd audit,
  staff informed the subcommittee that the audit report is not something HSB
  can speak to since it falls under economic development.
  • Members of the subcommittee will revisit and discuss the policy
  recommendations.

PUBLIC COMMENT
